shared_elements: low-relief carving on the broad face of a shaped upright slab/pillar
animal with long curving tail extending across the surface
animal placed on upper part of the shaft below a projecting head/capital
legs indicated in a schematic, outlined manner
justification: Both surfaces show a schematic quadruped in strict profile, carved in shallow relief with an exaggerated long sweeping tail, placed horizontally across the upper shaft of a shaped upright slab beneath a projecting head or lintel-like top — a highly specific and conventional combination rather than a generic "animal image". The main difference is that A carries a single isolated beast while B stacks at least two creatures (a heavier-bodied quadruped above and a further sinuous animal below), giving B a multi-figure composition where A has one.
